howto.name: Upload a text file
howto.text: Select one or more .txt files, up to 500 MB each; each file becomes its own PDF. Save the text as UTF-8 so accented characters come through.

howto.name: Know the fixed layout
howto.text: There are no formatting options: text is set in 11 pt Courier on A4 pages with 1-inch margins, and long lines wrap at spaces. Runs of spaces and tabs collapse to a single space, so indentation and space-aligned columns are not kept, and a single word longer than a line runs off the page.

howto.name: Generate the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The text is wrapped and paginated automatically into a PDF for you to download.

faq.q: Can I change the font and page size?
faq.a: No. Every PDF uses 11 pt Courier, a monospace font, on A4 pages with 1-inch margins; there are no font, size, page, or margin settings.

faq.q: Does the tool handle Unicode text?
faq.a: Only partly. The file must be UTF-8, and only Western European characters print, such as accented letters, curly quotes, and the euro sign. Other scripts, including Chinese, Arabic, Cyrillic, and Devanagari, come out as black boxes.

faq.q: Is there a character or line limit?
faq.a: There is no separate character or line limit, but the conversion has to finish within the two-minute request limit, so text files of tens of megabytes can time out. Split very large files first.
